notApplicable.size: Nodes, text, ports and canvas use explicit world geometry; global control size must not rescale diagram coordinates.
notApplicable.density: Diagram layout and world spacing are domain parameters. The component has no density geometry override.
notApplicable.disabled: FlowDiagram has no disabled prop; edit permissions belong to the render-prop host.
notApplicable.hover: FlowNode has no hover state API; pointer hit testing is exercised by real selection and dragging.
notApplicable.pressed: Transient pointer press has no independent diagram style; actual pointer capture is exercised during dragging.
notApplicable.loading: ELK loading is transient and uses the real asynchronous layout; video and ready/error assertions cover it without extending its duration.
notApplicable.expanded: The diagram exposes no expansion protocol.
